account.heading: Account
account.parsedCount: {{count}} tiered armor pieces parsed (vault, all characters, postmaster)
account.signOutNote: Sign out clears Bungie and DIM tokens from this browser session (session storage only). Preferences stay in local storage.

dupeRules.heading: Dupe rules
dupeRules.intro: Shared rules for heatmap, compare, browse, and redundant-roll lists.
dupeRules.minTierHelp: Vault import still loads tiers 1 through 5. Only pieces at or above this tier enter dupe buckets and redundant-roll checks.
dupeRules.groupingIntro: Pieces always match on class, slot, archetype, and tertiary stat. These options add stricter splits, and they apply to redundant-roll comparisons too.
dupeRules.dimTagsIntro: Tagged pieces stay visible but can be left out of dupe bucket sizes and review counts.

classDupeRules.heading: {{class}} dupe rules
classDupeRules.usingClass: Using {{class}} (change class in header). Classes share global rules by default. Apply a preset to one class without changing others.

language.heading: Language
language.useBrowserHelp: When on, the app follows your browser language. When off, use the language you pick below.

classPrefs.heading: {{class}} preferences
classPrefs.usingClass: Using {{class}} (change class in header). Per-class stat and archetype weights from calibration. Dupe rules are shared unless overridden per class.
classPrefs.queued_one: {{count}} tag queued to apply in DIM.
classPrefs.queued_other: {{count}} tags queued to apply in DIM.
classPrefs.confirmClearPending: Clear all {{count}} pending tags? They will not be applied to DIM.
classPrefs.confirmResetClass: Reset {{class}} preferences to defaults? Stat weights, calibration choices, and learned weights for this class will be cleared.
classPrefs.confirmResetAll: Reset preferences for all classes to defaults? Stat weights, calibration choices, and learned weights will be cleared for Hunter, Titan, and Warlock. Dupe rules and other settings are kept.
